0.msg: #b#p3001102##k tells me you did good work.

1.msg: I've been looking into the dragon relics you took from #rTreglow#k and #rVictor#k.

2.msg: As for #rVelderoth#k, I've prepared a tactic to help you reach him. It's somewhat different from our previous tactics... You'll see what I mean. I'll continue working on a way to reach #rMagnus#k.

3.msg: I'm waiting for word from #b#p3000001##k over at #b#m400000000##k. Would you speak to her for me?\r\n#r#e(You will move to the relevant field automatically upon accepting.)

0.msg: Then make your way to #b#m400000000##k and go see #b#p3000001##k.
Of course. It's only the fate of the world that hangs in the balance.

1.0: Ah, yes. #b#p3001100##k had questions about the relics, didn't she?\r\n#L0##b(You tell her about the relics you obtained from Treglow and Victor.)#l\n#k
1.1: I'm well versed in that sealing method. The medium is a little different from what we usually use here, but the ritual remains the same.\r\n#L0##bYou lost me at 'versed.'#l\n#k
1.2: All that matters is we determine how the relics are combined. If we know what materials are involved, the rest will fall into place. Let #b#p3001100##k know what I told you.\r\n\r\nAnd be careful. May the ancient Nova watch over you.
